rationale: The assistant correctly told the customer to stop resetting the trip, stop using the oven and get an electrician or appliance engineer, and its hedged explanation ('most likely... insulation failure, typically in one of the heating elements') matches the hidden truth without false certainty. However it asked no questions at all - it never established RCD vs MCB, burning smell/scorching, or whether the grill alone trips - so the handover lacks useful context and the customer can't take anything further to the engineer. Minor imprecision: telling the customer to leave a built-in oven 'unplugged' rather than isolating at the cooker switch, and calling the RCD the 'mains switch'. No fabrication, no parts, no loops.
